status: Source snapshot imported into Minglora with an independent consent-based identity bridge and Render blueprint. The current application still supports PayPal checkout/capture, payment history, verified webhooks and merchant records only; wallet transfers, stored-value balances, public merchant checkout and international remittance remain disabled/not implemented.
integrations: PayPal Payouts (administrator-only and disabled by default)
Dedicated HarborPay Supabase database and Auth project
removed_demo_components: Synthetic wallet and sample activity display
activation_requirements: Create and migrate a dedicated HarborPay Supabase project
Configure HarborPay Supabase Auth and transactional email
Configure PayPal Sandbox REST application credentials
Register the HarborPay PayPal webhook and store its webhook ID
Set server-only environment variables on the HarborPay API service
Complete the full Sandbox checkout and webhook verification checklist
Obtain PayPal Live and Payouts approvals before enabling real-money operations
Complete Jamaican regulatory/legal review before offering stored-value or money-transmission services
Apply 20261101000300_harborpay_minglora_identity_bridge.sql only to the dedicated HarborPay database
Configure the matching HARBORPAY_SSO_SECRET and MINGLORA_SSO_SECRET as distinct server-only values
Deploy separate HarborPay API and web services and configure the approved Minglora frame-ancestor origin
Complete country-by-country KYC/KYB, licensing, partner and reconciliation review before stored-value or remittance capabilities
